526:t_10:26.en:
$$アル$$
「That is wonderful. Thinking of the day the sergeant leaves the service, I would like to learn how to provide that support as well.」

526:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, as a dimensional merchant of some standing, I should be able to offer you all advice.」

526:t_10:28.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand the situation. I request your assistance.」

526:t_10:29.en:
$$アル$$
「I would appreciate your assistance too.」

526:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Society consists of connections between people. Thus, communication is one of the most important skills for participating in society.」

526:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the first ingredient for smooth communication is friendliness.」

526:t_10:33.en:
$$アル$$
「That is something both Ensign $$レド$$ and Sergeant $$相良$$ lack.」

526:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Supporting that is also part of your duties. First, let me demonstrate!」

526:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, let's give it our all today...!」

526:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That is excellent! You both show promise!」

527:t_000:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The $$デ・ダナン$$ has docked at $$ニケーロ島$$.」

527:t_000:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Everything is as expected so far... The $$クォーター$$'s diversion seems to have worked.」

527:t_000:2.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「That base... Is that $$アマルガム$$'s stronghold?」

527:t_001:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's our $$テッサ$$. She located $$アマルガム$$'s base with just the information $$宗介$$ gathered in $$ナムサク$$.」

527:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Don't be tactless. You'll make yourself less of a man.」

527:t_001:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And our $$Ｍ９$$s got a perfect upgrade, too!」

527:t_001:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Your machine's '《$$妖精の目$$》' is an ultra-high-performance sensor. It detects fields around enemy machines and how they are moving.」

527:t_001:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Combine that with my sniping, and I can kill with one shot!」

527:t_001:6.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「This isn't good. It looks like I'll be at a disadvantage in our contest for $c's number-one sniper.」

527:t_001:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$ベン$$'s $$ファルケ$$ has reinforced joints so it can withstand even more extreme movements than before.」

527:t_001:8.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I can express my art to the fullest now.」

527:t_001:9.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「His incredible close-combat tactics will be even stronger.」

527:t_001:10.en:
$$スザク$$
「This should be quite a sight.」

527:t_001:11.en:
$$マオ$$
「My $$Ｍ９$$'s ITCC-5 can control unmanned units through its data link. I'll use it to form Sis $$マオ$$'s personal guard!」

527:t_001:12.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Combined with my $$ゴースト$$s, we could disrupt the enemy from both land and air.」

527:t_001:13.en:
$$レド$$
「But that isn't all we have.」

527:t_002:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Of course they are. $$宗介$$ has waited so long for this day.」

527:t_002:2.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
(I understand $$宗介$$, but is $n like that too?)

527:t_002:3.en:
$$クラン$$
(He's played dumb about Miss $$スズネ$$ so often... Could he actually have feelings he's been hiding...?)

527:t_002:4.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「They're burning with fighting spirit for the ones they love.」

527:t_002:5.en:
$$桂$$
「I like that! I'll support you with everything I've got!」

527:t_002:6.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$宗介$$, $n. Leave the backup to us.」

527:t_002:7.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Be careful. An interception force has emerged.」

527:t_003:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ファイヤバグ$$ is here too!」

527:t_003:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$クロウ$$! Your honey's here!」

527:t_003:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Ugh... Hearing even you say that really hurts.」

527:t_003:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Speaking of old adversaries, our regular is here too.」

527:t_003:7.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$! $$シャッコ$$, $$カレン$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! The day has come to settle things with you!」

527:t_003:8.en:
$$キリコ$$
「The red $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ unit isn't here.」

527:t_003:9.en:
$$カレン$$
「Neither is that gold-plated thug, so we won't lose on raw power!」

527:t_003:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「As $$エスター$$ would say, you're out of sight and out of mind!」

527:t_003:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can't waste time on small fry! I'll take their stronghold in one push!」

527:t_003:15.en:
$$サビーナ$$
「I apologize that the enemy's rapid deployment delayed your evacuation, $$レナード$$.」

527:t_003:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「It's fine. This much is within my predictions.」

527:t_003:18.en:
$$レナード$$
「Fortunately, the ARX-8's transport arrived in time.」

527:t_003:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「By crushing it before their eyes, we'll teach them to give up.」

527:t_004:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「It should be about time, though this is rather like putting on a show...」

527:t_005:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, be careful! The enemy's main force has appeared!」

527:t_006:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「The $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ units are here!」

527:t_006:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「With this much firepower, that obnoxious silver-haired bastard must be here!」

527:t_007:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I need covering fire. I'm going to break through.」

527:t_008:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「That's too bad! You're right in my strike zone!」

527:t_010:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「It's fragile, far too fragile... To think this is the white $$ミスリル$$ machine that gave me so much trouble...」

527:t_010:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I'm just kidding! Of course that's what happens to an empty shell without a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」
